other_conditions: The applicant must be a resident and farmer of Arunachal Pradesh.
Collateral security in the form of land/property or an acceptable guarantee is required for loan amounts exceeding Rs 1.6 lakh for individuals and Rs 10 lakh for SHGs/FPOs.
No collateral is needed for loans up to Rs 1.6 lakh for individuals or Rs 10 lakh for SHGs.
benefits_summary: Provides a 45% government subsidy, 45% bank loan and 10% farmer contribution for credit to cultivate specified fruits, with collateral waived up to Rs 1.6 lakh (Rs 10 lakh for SHGs).
